fieldNotes.location: Supplied coords were ROOFTOP-precision (movedMeters 125) and landed on the correct building. Confirmed via web research (226 East View Drive, Mt. Pleasant PA 15666, Performance Foodservice Pittsburgh Division, 724-696-2200) and Street View, which shows a 'PERFORMANCE FOODSERVICE' branded building and a Performance Foodservice monument sign at the East View Drive entrance.
fieldNotes.truckGate: No barrier arm, sliding gate, or checkpoint pinch-point. The truck driveway runs open from East View Drive up to the building. Perimeter chain-link fencing surrounds the property, but the entrance driveway itself is uncontrolled in both 2023 and 2024 Street View captures.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No small staffed booth structure beside the driveway. The dark peaked-roof structure at the building's south side is the office entry portico of the main building, not a guard shack. A booth is not visible in Street View either — confidence high that there is none.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock banks on two physically separate building faces: a long dock line on the east face (with a dedicated trailer drop yard) and a second dock line on the southwest/west face. Consistent with separate inbound-receiving and outbound-shipping clusters.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Estimated ~58 total — a long east dock line (~30-35 doors, ~15-20 trailers backed in) plus a west/southwest dock line (~20-25 doors). Banded 50+; roof glare makes the exact count an estimate.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Trailer drop yard along the east side of the building holds ~25-40 trailers in marked rows.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town industrial park outside Mt. Pleasant PA, ringed by forest, reclaimed land and farm fields — small-town / rural setting.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs through the wooded corridor north of the property, but no spur enters the PFG site — railServed false.
fieldNotes.entryExitTogether: Single driveway off East View Drive serves as both entry and exit.
